message.content:
Lion (Panthera leo) and zebra (Equus quagga) diverge at the level of the clade **Laurasiatheria**.  
Both belong to this group—lion in the order *Carnivora* and zebra in the order *Perissodactyla*—so their most recent common ancestor is the last common ancestor of all Laurasiatherian mammals.
